 Medicare open enrollment can bring plenty of questions, but understanding your options can help you make more informed decisions. Len Hayduchok, CEO of Dedicated Financial, and Shane Scott, a certified financial planner, join CoastLife to break down Medicare Parts A, B, C, and D and explain what beneficiaries should know when reviewing their coverage.
